d:
Insani sharir halat ke mutabiq dhal sakta hai, bahut kuchh jhel sakta hai aur iski kshamtaen hairan karne vali hain. sachmuch ek ‘haee-parformens mashin’. insan hamesha se apni haden parakhta aaya hai. lekin asal men ham kitna sah sakte hain?
Ye film dikhati hai ki hamara sharir kitna kuchh kar sakta hai, aur kab vo saf sanket deta hai ki ab bahut ho gaya. aakhir sharir ki had kahan hai? aur agar ham use par kar jaen, to kya hota hai?
